jules (Growth): Heads-up: PartnerGrid asked for a combined marketplace listing + 30m demo + 15m Q&A. They want a short launch post, marketplace blurb, and a benchmark callout. Target window ~3 weeks. Who can own content, routing, and assets?

maria (Partnerships): We can co-host and supply logos, speaker bios, and a benchmark slide. Legal wants 48h to approve any customer quote. Prefer June 22 or 24 for the session.

eno (Content): Deliverables: 1) 3-bullet marketplace blurb, 2) 700-word launch blog that doubles as listing copy, 3) email announce + reminder. I can draft blurb + landing copy by Tue. Need benchmark numbers and 2 screenshots.

brad (Marketing): Owners: eno -> content, jules -> routing/tracking, maria -> partner assets/legal. I'll own promo calendar and host.

jules (Growth): Routing details: SFDC campaign = "PG_Marketplace_Jun"; utm_source=partnergrid; utm_campaign=pg_jun_launch. Registration fields: name, email, company, role, monthly token bracket. Add hidden field "pg_ref". Gate recording to collect leads; webhook -> our lead lambda.

maria (Partnerships): Sending assets Mon AM. I'll also ask partner for a short customer quote; will report back on permission.

eno (Content): For benchmark callout, can eng confirm a one-line stat like "reduces per-token cost by up to 35%"? If not, I'll hedge with "up to ~35%". Need sign-off before publishing.

ops-bot: Calendar slot suggestion: June 24 10:00 PT available.

brad (Marketing): Promo cadence: teaser 3w out, registration open 2w out, reminders at 1w and 2d. Social banners ready 10 days prior. We'll repurpose recording into short clips.

jules (Growth): I'll provision SFDC campaign + webhook today. @eng-platform please confirm webhook auth (api-key or JWT) by EOD Mon.

eno (Content): Quick ask 00000can we capture a 45s demo highlight in rehearsal for social? Production can take it.

maria (Partnerships): Confirmed on rehearsal. Legal review for quote by Wed.

brad (Marketing): Next steps recap: eno drafts copy (due Tue), jules sets up routing (due Mon), maria delivers assets + quote status (due Wed), brad finalizes promo calendar (due Thu). Locking June 24 unless objections. :rocket:

maria (Partnerships): All good from partner side. Excited to launch. :handshake:

jules (Growth): Routing on my side, will ping once webhook is live.
